examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akaṅkhī hoti avicikicchī niṭṭhaṅ'gato saddhamme. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati. tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, akaṅkhī vat'amhi avicikicchī niṭṭhaṅ'gato saddhamme'ti.

10516.meaning1: eggshell of ignorance; shell of delusion

10517.commentary: (NIDD2a) kilesatamaṃ avijj'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā'ti kilesatamasaṅkhātaṃ aññāṇaṃ avijj'andhakāraṃ nīharitvā nāsetvā.

examples.text: kathaṃ, bhante, obhāsanalakkhaṇā paññā'ti? paññā, mahārāja, uppajjamānā avijj'andhakāraṃ vidhameti, vijj'obhāsaṃ janeti, ñāṇ'ālokaṃ vidaṃseti, ariyasaccāni pākaṭāni karoti. tato yog'āvacaro aniccan'ti vā dukkhan'ti vā anattā'ti vā sammappaññāya passatī'ti.

10518.grammar: prp of na vijjati, neg, pass, intrans

examples.text: assutavā, bhikkhave, puthujjano yaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, atthi mahāsamudde pātālo'ti. taṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano asantaṃ avijjamānaṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, atthi mahāsamudde pātālo'ti. sārīrikānaṃ kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhānaṃ vedanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ yadidaṃ pātālo'ti.

10519.meaning1: ignorance truly I; delusion certainly I (say)

examples.text: avijjam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro avijjāya?

10520.meaning1: ignorance; illusion; not knowing; not understanding

examples.text: rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
avijjāya nivuto loko, vevicchā pamādā nappakāsati, japp'ābhilepanaṃ brūmi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayaṃ.

10522.meaning1: mass of ignorance; mass of misunderstanding
10522.commentary: (ANa) avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletī'ti arahattamaggena padāleti nāmā'ti vuccati. iminā hi heṭṭhā arahattamaggena avijjākkhandho padālito, idha pana padālitaṃ upādāya padāletī'ti vattuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahato kāyassa padāletā hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahantaṃ avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletā. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahato kāyassa padāletā hoti.
seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo mahato kāyassa padāletā, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammāvimutti hoti. sammāvimutti, sāḷha, ariyasāvako mahantaṃ avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletī'ti.
ato mahantatarena, aggivessana, avijjākhandhena jayaseno rājakumāro āvuto nivuto ophuṭo pariyonaddho.

10524.meaning1: immersed in ignorance; delusional; gone crazy

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, avijjāgato tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vipāko.
evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bakaṃ brahmānaṃ etadavocaṃ, avijjāgato vata, bho, bako brahmā, avijjāgato vata, bho, bako brahmā. yatra hi nāma aniccaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ niccan'ti vakkhati
saṅkhārā c'ime, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? saṅkhārā avijjānidānā avijjāsamudayā avijjājātikā avijjāpabhavā.
cakkhu'ndriyassa sot'indriyassa ghān'indriyassa jivh'indriyassa kāy'indriyassa. atthi, bhikkhave, mano, atthi dhammā, atthi avijjādhātu.

siyā, ānanda. cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
saṅkhārā c'ime, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? saṅkhārā avijjānidānā avijjāsamudayā avijjājātikā avijjāpabhavā.

10528.meaning1: ending of ignorance; cessation of not understanding

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, āsavanirodho? avijjānirodho, bhikkhave, āsavanirodho. ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā

yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako avijjañ'ca pajānāti, avijjāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

10529.meaning1: leading to the ending of ignorance; leading to the cessation of nescience

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako avijjañ'ca pajānāti, avijjāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

10530.meaning1: shrouded with ignorance; enveloped with delusion

examples.text: rāgadosaparikkiṭṭhā, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā, avijjānivutā posā, piyarūp'ābhinandino.

10531.meaning1: impeded by ignorance; obstructed by not understanding

examples.text: iti kho, ānanda, kammaṃ khettaṃ, viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ, taṇhā sneho. avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ hīnāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hoti.
pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.

10533.meaning1: underlying tendency towards ignorance; inherent inclination towards not understanding

examples.text: kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
sukhāya, bhikkhave, vedanāya rāg'ānusayo pahātabbo, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭigh'ānusayo pahātabbo, adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya avijj'ānusayo pahātabbo.

10535.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of avijjāpaccaya
10535.meaning1: dependent on ignorance; due to not understanding

examples.text: avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā
yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ avijjāpaccayā

10536.meaningLit: discourse on the question about ignorance

10537.meaning1: produced by ignorance; generated by nescience

examples.text: saṅkhārā c'ime, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? saṅkhārā avijjānidānā avijjāsamudayā avijjājātikā avijjāpabhavā.

10538.meaningLit: discourse on the abandoning of ignorance

10539.meaning1: smashing of ignorance; breaking through illusion
10539.commentary: (ANa) avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karotī'ti aṭṭhasu ṭhānesu aññāṇabhūtāya gaṇabahalamahāavijjāya pabhedasaṅkhātaṃ arahattaṃ manasi karoti.

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati. so avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karoti. tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati n'ādhimuccati.

10540.meaning1: rooted in ignorance; stemming from not knowing
10540.commentary: (NIDD2a) sabbe te avijjā mūlaṃ kāraṇaṃ etesan'ti avijjāmūlakā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅ'gamā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭasamugghātā sabbā tā samugghātaṃ gacchanti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci akusalā dhammā sabbe te avijjāmūlakā avijjāsamosaraṇā avijjāsamugghātā, sabbe te samugghātaṃ gacchanti.

10541.meaning1: yoke of ignorance; bondage of not understanding
10541.commentary: (ANa) catūsu saccesu aññāṇaṃ avijjāyogo … avijjāya yojetī'ti avijjāyogo'ti

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, yogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.

10542.meaning1: detachment from the bond of ignorance

examples.text: cattāro visaññogā, kāmayogavisaññogo, bhavayogavisaññogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo, avijjāyogavisaññogo.

10543.meaning1: detachment from the bond of ignorance; disconnection from the bondage of not understanding

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, visaṃyogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogavisaṃyogo, bhavayogavisaṃyogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo, avijjāyogavisaṃyogo.

10544.meaning1: bond of ignorance; fetter of not knowing

examples.text: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

10545.meaning1: surpassing ignorance; overcoming not knowing; transcending illusion

examples.text: chandarāgassa vinayā, avijjāsamatikkamā, taṃ ñāṇaṃ param'odānaṃ, kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape.
ye rāgadosavinayā, avijjāsamatikkamā, sekkhā apacay'ārāmā, appamattānusikkhare, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.

10546.meaning1: eradication of ignorance; destruction of not understanding

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅ'gamā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭasamugghātā sabbā tā samugghātaṃ gacchanti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci akusalā dhammā sabbe te avijjāmūlakā avijjāsamosaraṇā avijjāsamugghātā, sabbe te samugghātaṃ gacchanti.

10547.meaning1: source of ignorance; arising of not knowing

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako avijjañ'ca pajānāti, avijjāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, avijjānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

10548.meaning1: with ignorance as source; originating from nescience
10548.commentary: (MNa) avijjāsamudayā'ti ettha pana kusalānaṃ upanissayavasena akusalānaṃ sahajāt'ādi-vasenā'pi avijjāpaccayo hotī'ti veditabbā. (MNa) āsavavāre avijjāsamudayā'ti ettha avijjā kām'āsava-bhav'āsavānaṃ sahajāt'ādi-vasena paccayo hoti. avijj'āsavassa upanissayavaseneva. apar'āpar'uppannā c'ettha avijjā avijj'āsavo'ti veditabbā. pubb'uppannā avijjāy'ev'assa apar'āpar'uppannassa avijj'āsavassa upanissayapaccayo hoti.

examples.text: saṅkhārā c'ime, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? saṅkhārā avijjānidānā avijjāsamudayā avijjājātikā avijjāpabhavā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅ'gamā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭasamugghātā sabbā tā samugghātaṃ gacchanti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci akusalā dhammā sabbe te avijjāmūlakā avijjāsamosaraṇā avijjāsamugghātā, sabbe te samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
atthi, bhikkhave, mano, atthi dhammā, atthi avijjādhātu. avijjāsamphassajena, bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa asmī'ti'pi'ssa hoti, ayam'aham'asmī'ti'pi'ssa hoti…
tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kām'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati bhav'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati avijj'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati
tayo'me, bhikkhave, āsavā, kām'āsavo, bhav'āsavo, avijj'āsavo.

10552.meaning1: bond of ignorance; fetter of not knowing

examples.text: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

10557.meaning2: Chapter 13 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

10558.meaning2: Chapter 6 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

10559.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

10560.meaning1: removal of ignorance; dispelling not knowing
10560.commentary: (ANa) avijjāvinaye'ti avijjāvinayo vuccati arahattaṃ, taṃnissite dhamme desiyamāne'ti attho.

examples.text: avijjāgatā, bhikkhave, pajā aṇḍabhūtā pariyonaddhā. sā tathāgatena avijjāvinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti. tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.

10561.meaning1: fading of ignorance; cessation of nescience
10561.commentary: (ANa) avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti avijjāya khayavirāgena paññāvimutti nāma hoti.

examples.text: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti? avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijj'uppādā taṇhānirodhā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti.
rāg'upakkiliṭṭhaṃ vā, bhikkhave, cittaṃ na vimuccati, avijj'upakkiliṭṭhā vā paññā bhāvīyati. iti kho, bhikkhave, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti.

10562.meaning1: ill effect of the poison of ignorance; poisonous humour of non-understanding
10562.commentary: (PMa) avijjāvisadosasallitto'ti avijjāy'eva akusal'uppādanena kusalajīvitanāsanato visan'ti avijjāvisaṃ, tadeva santānadūsanato avijjāvisadoso, tena anusayapariyuṭṭhāna-duccaritabhūtena bhusaṃ litto makkhito'ti avijjāvisadosasallitto.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evam'assa, taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso, chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.

10563.meaning1: defiled by ignorance; contaminated with not knowing

examples.text: rāg'upakkiliṭṭhaṃ vā, bhikkhave, cittaṃ na vimuccati, avijj'upakkiliṭṭhā vā paññā bhāvīyati. iti kho, bhikkhave, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti.

10564.commentary: (SNa) evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā'ti-ādīsu avijjā pabbato'ti daṭṭhabbā. abhisaṅkhārā megho'ti, viññāṇ'ādivaṭṭaṃ kandar'ādayo'ti, vimutti sāgaro'ti.
